fullDescription: A complete pill-button design system on one vibrant reference page: two gradient color stories (teal->lime #14b8a6->#a3e635 and coral->amber #ff6b4a->#ffb020) across four variants (fill, gradient outline, soft, icon-only), four sizes (XS 34px, SM 40px, MD 48px, LG 58px) and six interaction states (default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading). A sticky frosted nav and a dotted-grid hero with a live-preview card open onto five labeled sections: variants (two gradient columns), a sizes scale table, a six-state grid, an icons & composition block, and a tokens palette closed by a gradient-bordered dark CTA. Fully-rounded pills on a light #f7f8fa canvas with near-black ink text, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Iconify Phosphor icons; dense tables scroll on mobile instead of clipping.

structured.summary: A complete pill-button design system on one vibrant reference page: two gradient color stories (teal->lime #14b8a6->#a3e635 and coral->amber #ff6b4a->#ffb020) rendered across four variants (fill, gradient outline, soft, and icon-only), four sizes (XS 34px, SM 40px, MD 48px, LG 58px), and six interaction states (default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading). The page opens with a sticky frosted nav and a dotted-grid hero ('Buttons that glow, in every state.') beside a live-preview spec card, then walks five labeled sections: 01 Variants (two gradient columns each showing fill/outline/soft/icon), 02 Sizes (a four-row size scale per gradient), 03 Interaction states (a six-state grid per variant), 04 Icons & composition (leading/trailing/icon-only/count/split/full-width), and 05 Tokens (the two gradient stops + an ink scale, closed by a gradient-bordered dark CTA strip). Built on a light #f7f8fa canvas with near-black ink text, fully-rounded 9999px pills, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Iconify Phosphor icons; dense state/size tables scroll horizontally on mobile rather than clip. The library value is the transferable two-gradient pill token system plus the section-by-section state/size documentation layout.

style.description: A vibrant, playful-but-polished modern-SaaS aesthetic built around fully-rounded pill buttons and two punchy linear gradients. The canvas is light #f7f8fa with near-black ink text (#141823) and a graphite/slate ink scale for secondary copy (#4c5466, #6b7384, #9aa3b4). Two gradient 'color stories' carry every accent: teal->lime (linear-gradient(100deg, #14b8a6 0%, #5fce8f 48%, #a3e635 100%)) and coral->amber (linear-gradient(100deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff8f3a 50%, #ffb020 100%)). Buttons are pills (border-radius 9999px), 700 weight, with a 140% background-size that slides on hover (background-position 0%->100%) for a living-gradient shimmer, plus layered depth (a colored drop shadow 0 8px 22px -10px that deepens on hover, and an inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35) top highlight); active presses inward (inset shadow + translateY 1px). Surfaces are airy white spec cards (.spec = #fff, 1px #e6e9f0 border, 24px radius, a soft 0 18px 40px -28px shadow). The mood is energetic and demo-forward: a faint 22px radial dotted hero backdrop, tiny uppercase tracked labels (.lbl 11px/700/.14em), monospace code pills for hex tokens, and dark gradient-clipped headline words. Dark moments (the CTA strip + token footer) use ink-950 #0a0d15. Typography is Plus Jakarta Sans throughout (400/500/600/700/800), extrabold for headlines.
style.prompt: Use a vibrant modern-SaaS pill-button design system on the Tailwind CDN with these EXACT custom tokens. Ink (slate) scale: 50 #f7f8fa, 100 #eef0f4, 200 #dfe3ea, 300 #c4cad6, 400 #9aa3b4, 500 #6b7384, 600 #4c5466, 700 #363d4d, 800 #222836, 900 #141823, 950 #0a0d15. Accent colors: teal 400 #2dd4bf / 500 #14b8a6 / 600 #0d9488, lime 400 #a3e635 / 500 #84cc16, coral 400 #ff8a6b / 500 #ff6b4a / 600 #f0502d, amber 400 #ffc24a / 500 #ffb020. Body is `bg-[#f7f8fa] text-ink-900` and antialiased. Font (Google Fonts): Plus Jakarta Sans, weights 400/500/600/700/800, set as the `sans` family with `system-ui, sans-serif` fallbacks, plus `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility`. Define two gradient CSS variables: `--g-tl: linear-gradient(100deg,#14b8a6 0%,#5fce8f 48%,#a3e635 100%)` (hover `--g-tl-hover: linear-gradient(100deg,#0d9488 0%,#4cc485 48%,#92d822 100%)`, active `--g-tl-active: linear-gradient(100deg,#0a7d72 0%,#3aac6f 48%,#7bbd16 100%)`) and `--g-ca: linear-gradient(100deg,#ff6b4a 0%,#ff8f3a 50%,#ffb020 100%)` (hover `--g-ca-hover: linear-gradient(100deg,#f0502d 0%,#ff7d23 50%,#f59e0a 100%)`, active `--g-ca-active: linear-gradient(100deg,#db4321 0%,#ef6f17 50%,#de8b00 100%)`), plus a focus ring `--ring: 0 0 0 3px #f7f8fa, 0 0 0 5px rgba(20,184,166,.55)`. Every button is a `.btn` pill: `inline-flex items-center justify-center; gap:.55rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.005em; line-height:1; border-radius:9999px; border:1.6px solid transparent; transition: background-position .35s ease, box-shadow .22s ease, transform .12s ease, color .18s, border-color .18s, opacity .18s; outline:none` with `.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}`. Add a faint hero backdrop `.dotgrid` = `radial-gradient(rgba(20,24,35,.06) 1px, transparent 1px)` at `background-size:22px 22px`. Spec cards use `.spec` (`#fff; border:1px solid #e6e9f0; border-radius:24px; box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(20,24,35,.02),0 18px 40px -28px rgba(20,24,35,.22)`). Tiny labels use `.lbl` (`11px/700; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#4c5466`) and `.statelbl` (`11px/600; letter-spacing:.04em; color:#4c5466`); hex tokens use `.codepill` (`font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size:11.5px`). Keep the canvas light and the two gradients the only loud color; everything else is white, ink text, and hairline #e6e9f0/#eef0f4 borders. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*).

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column documentation page: a `sticky top-0 z-50` frosted nav (`bg-[#f7f8fa]/80 backdrop-blur-md` over `border-b border-ink-200/70`) with a gradient pill-logo lockup ('Pillbox' + a v1.0 chip), five anchor links (Variants/Sizes/States/Icons/Tokens), a Docs link and a teal-gradient 'Get the kit' button; a full-bleed `.dotgrid` hero of a two-column `lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_.95fr]` layout (left: a dual-swatch badge, the extrabold gradient-clipped headline 'Buttons that glow, in every state.', a subhead, two CTAs, and a two-item checklist; right: a `.spec` live-preview card showing six buttons + an icon toolbar + a loading button); then full-width sections each opened by a `.lbl` numbered eyebrow + extrabold H2 + slate subhead: 01 Variants (a 2-col grid of two gradient columns, each Fill/Outline/Soft/Icon), 02 Sizes (a `.spec` table of four size rows x two gradient columns, horizontally scrollable), 03 Interaction states (a `.spec` table of four variant rows x six state columns Default/Hover/Active/Focus/Disabled/Loading, horizontally scrollable), 04 Icons & composition (a 3-col grid of six `.spec` cards: leading / trailing / icon-only / count / split-group / full-width), and 05 Tokens (a 3-col grid of two gradient swatch cards + an ink-scale card, then a gradient-bordered dark CTA strip); closed by a light footer with the pill-logo lockup and three anchor links. Sections alternate white and #f7f8fa backgrounds and are separated by `border-ink-200/70` hairlines.

Left: a logo lockup = a `grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-full text-white shadow-sm` tile with `style="background-image:var(--g-tl)"` holding a `ph:pill-fill` Iconify icon (18px, color #06241f), beside 'Pillbox' in `text-[17px] font-extrabold tracking-tight` and a `rounded-full bg-ink-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wide text-ink-500` 'v1.0' chip. Center (`hidden md:flex` gap-7): five `.navlink` (`font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:#4c5466; hover:color:#141823`) anchor links Variants/Sizes/States/Icons/Tokens pointing at the section ids. Right (`flex items-center gap-3`): a `.navlink hidden sm:inline` 'Docs' link + a `.btn .btn-sm .g-tl` 'Get the kit' button with a trailing `ph:arrow-right-bold` icon.

Left column: a dual-swatch badge (`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-ink-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-600` with a teal-gradient `.swatch` dot, the text 'Gradient button system', and a coral-gradient `.swatch` dot); an `mt-6 text-[44px] md:text-[58px] font-extrabold leading-[1.04] tracking-[-.02em]` H1 'Buttons that glow, in every state.' where the words 'glow' and 'state' are gradient-clipped (`bg-clip-text text-transparent` with `background-image:var(--g-tl)` and `var(--g-ca)` respectively); an `mt-5 max-w-[30rem] text-[16.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` subhead; an `mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3.5` CTA row of a `.btn .btn-lg .g-tl` 'Generate a set' (`ph:sparkle-fill`) + a `.btn .btn-lg .o-ca` outline 'Browse variants'; and an `mt-8 flex items-center gap-5 text-[12.5px] font-medium text-ink-500` checklist of two items ('WCAG-checked contrast', 'Copy-ready tokens') each led by a teal `ph:check-circle-fill`. Right column: a `.spec p-7` live-preview card with a header row ('LIVE PREVIEW' `.lbl` + four solid color swatches #14b8a6/#a3e635/#ff6b4a/#ffb020), a `mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4` of six `.btn .btn-md` buttons (Confirm `g-tl`, Upgrade `g-ca`, Preview `o-tl`, Share `o-ca`, Save draft `s-tl`, Add note `s-ca`), and a `mt-6 flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl bg-ink-50 px-4 py-3` strip of three `.btn-icon-sm` icon buttons (g-tl heart, o-ca bookmark, s-tl share) + a `.btn .btn-sm .g-ca .is-loading` 'Saving' button with a `.spin` spinner.

A `#variants border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white` section with an inner `mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 py-16 md:py-20`. Header (`max-w-xl`): a `.lbl` '01 · Variants', an `mt-3 text-[30px] md:text-[34px] font-extrabold tracking-tight` H2 'Four ways to wear the gradient', and an `mt-3 text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600` subhead. Body: an `mt-10 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2` of two `.spec p-7` columns. Each column header is a `flex items-center gap-2.5` row of a `h-3 w-12 rounded-full` gradient bar (`style=background-image:var(--g-tl)` / `var(--g-ca)`), the name ('Teal -> Lime' / 'Coral -> Amber') in `text-[15px] font-bold`, and a `.codepill ml-auto rounded-md bg-ink-50 px-2 py-1 text-ink-500` hex chip ('#14b8a6 -> #a3e635' / '#ff6b4a -> #ffb020'). Below, an `mt-6 space-y-5` stack of four labeled rows (each a `.statelbl mb-2.5` + the button): Fill = `.btn .btn-md .g-tl|.g-ca`; Outline = `.btn .btn-md .o-tl|.o-ca` (wrap label in `<span class="core">`); Soft = `.btn .btn-md .s-tl|.s-ca`; Icon = a `flex gap-2.5` of three `.btn-icon-md` buttons (gradient plus, outline pencil, soft gear).

A `#sizes border-b border-ink-200/70` section with the same header pattern: `.lbl` '02 · Sizes', H2 'A scale that stays balanced', subhead. Body: a `.spec mt-10 overflow-hidden` wrapping a `.scroll-x` (`overflow-x:auto`) holding a `.sizes-grid` (`grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(180px,1fr) minmax(180px,1fr); min-width:560px`). A header row (`border-b border-ink-100 px-7 py-3.5`) of three `.lbl` cells (Size / Teal -> Lime / Coral -> Amber), then four data rows (`border-b border-ink-100 px-7 py-5`, the last without border) each a `.statelbl` size cell + a teal button + a coral button at that size: 'XS · 34' (`.btn-xs`), 'SM · 40' (`.btn-sm`), 'MD · 48' (`.btn-md`), 'LG · 58' (`.btn-lg`), all labeled 'Get started'. Pill heights: `.btn-xs` 34px/px-16/12.5px, `.btn-sm` 40px/px-20/13.5px, `.btn-md` 48px/px-26/15px, `.btn-lg` 58px/px-34/16.5px.

A `#states border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white` section: `.lbl` '03 · Interaction states', H2 'Every state, mapped and labeled', subhead. Body: a `.spec mt-10 overflow-hidden` wrapping a `.scroll-x` holding a `.states-grid` (`grid-template-columns: 150px repeat(6, minmax(98px,1fr)); min-width:760px`). A header row (`bg-ink-50/60 px-6 py-3.5`) of a `.lbl` 'Variant' + six centered `.statelbl` (Default/Hover/Active/Focus/Disabled/Loading), then four variant rows (`border-b border-ink-100 px-6 py-5`, last without border) each a `text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-700` name + six centered cells rendering the same button in each state via forced-state helper classes: 'Fill · Teal' (`.g-tl` 'Save'), 'Fill · Coral' (`.g-ca` 'Publish'), 'Outline · Teal' (`.o-tl` 'Filter', label in `.core`), 'Soft · Coral' (`.s-ca` 'Reset'). The state cells use `.is-hover`, `.is-active`, `.is-focus`, `.is-disabled`, and `.is-loading` (with a `.spin` spinner before the label).

An `#icons border-b border-ink-200/70` section: `.lbl` '04 · Icons & composition', H2 'Icons lead, follow, or stand alone', subhead. Body: an `mt-10 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-3` of six `.spec p-7` cards, each with a `.statelbl mb-4` caption: (1) 'Leading icon' = `.g-tl` Download (`ph:download-simple-bold`) + `.o-ca` Upload; (2) 'Trailing icon' = `.g-ca` Continue (`ph:arrow-right-bold`) + `.s-tl` Options (`ph:caret-down-bold`); (3) 'Icon only' = four `.btn-icon-lg` (g-tl play, g-ca lightning, o-tl dots, s-ca trash); (4) 'With count label' = `.g-tl` Like with a `rounded-full bg-white/35 px-2 py-0.5` '24' pill + `.s-ca` Reply with a coral '8' pill; (5) 'Split / group' = a `.g-tl !rounded-r-none pr-4` 'Deploy' joined to a `.btn-icon-md .g-tl !rounded-l-none` caret with a white/40 left divider; (6) 'Full-width' = a `.btn .btn-md .g-ca w-full` Checkout (`ph:credit-card-fill`).

prompts.prompt: A `#tokens bg-white` section: `.lbl` '05 · Tokens', H2 'The palette behind the pills', subhead. Body: an `mt-10 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-3` of three `.spec overflow-hidden` cards, the first two with an `h-24` gradient header (`var(--g-tl)` / `var(--g-ca)`) then a `p-6` body listing the two stops as `.swatch` + name + `.codepill` hex; the third with a four-segment `flex h-24` ink-scale header (#141823/#4c5466/#9aa3b4/#eef0f4) then an ink-scale body. Then a `mt-12 rounded-[28px] p-[1.6px]` strip with a four-stop gradient border (`linear-gradient(100deg,#14b8a6,#a3e635 45%,#ffb020 70%,#ff6b4a)`) wrapping a `rounded-[26px] bg-ink-950 px-8 py-12 text-center md:text-left flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between items-center gap-5`: a left block (H3 'Drop the whole pill system into your next prompt' in `text-[26px] font-extrabold text-white` + a `text-ink-300` subhead) and a right `flex shrink-0 gap-3` of a `.btn .btn-lg .g-tl` 'Generate now' (`ph:sparkle-fill`) + a `.btn .btn-lg .g-ca` 'Copy tokens'. Close with a `<footer class="border-t border-ink-200/70 bg-[#f7f8fa]">` of a `mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 py-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4` row: a left pill-logo lockup ('Pillbox · gradient button system') and three right `text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-500 hover:text-ink-800` anchor links (Variants/States/Tokens).

special_ui_components.prompt: Every button is a fully-rounded pill `.btn` (`inline-flex items-center justify-center; gap:.55rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.005em; line-height:1; border-radius:9999px; border:1.6px solid transparent; transition: background-position .35s ease, box-shadow .22s ease, transform .12s ease, color/border/opacity .18s; outline:none`, with `.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}`). Compose four treatments per gradient: FILL `.g-tl`/`.g-ca` (the gradient as `background-image` with `background-size:140% 100%; background-position:0% 50%`, a colored drop shadow + an inset white top highlight, ink text #06241f for teal / #3a1605 for coral); OUTLINE `.o-tl`/`.o-ca` (a 1.6px gradient ring made by `padding:1.6px; background:var(--g-tl|--g-ca); border-radius:9999px` with an inner `<span class="core">` white pill carrying the colored label #0a7d72 / #c63d1d); SOFT `.s-tl`/`.s-ca` (tinted `#e8faf5`/`#fff0eb` background with the deep accent text); and square ICON `.btn-icon-sm|md|lg` reusing any treatment at equal width/height.

Fill buttons get a shimmer on hover by sizing the gradient larger than the button (`background-size:140% 100%`) and animating `background-position` from `0% 50%` to `100% 50%` over `.35s ease`, while swapping to the deeper hover gradient (`--g-tl-hover` / `--g-ca-hover`) and lifting the colored drop shadow (e.g. teal `0 8px 22px -10px rgba(20,184,166,.6)` -> `0 14px 30px -10px rgba(20,184,166,.72)`). Active swaps to the darkest gradient (`--g-tl-active` / `--g-ca-active`), replaces the lift with an `inset 0 3px 7px` press shadow, and nudges `translateY(1px)`.

Mirror the real pseudo-states with helper classes so a static documentation grid can render all six: `.is-hover`/`.is-active`/`.is-focus` duplicate the `:hover`/`:active`/`:focus-visible` rules; `.is-focus` shows the focus ring `--ring` (`0 0 0 3px #f7f8fa, 0 0 0 5px rgba(20,184,166,.55)`, the coral variants using `rgba(255,107,74,.55)`); `.is-disabled` = `opacity:.42; cursor:not-allowed; box-shadow:none !important; filter:saturate(.6)`; `.is-loading` = `pointer-events:none` with a `.spin` ring spinner (`1.05em square; border:2.2px solid currentColor; border-top-color:transparent; border-radius:9999px; animation:rot .7s linear infinite`) placed before the label.

Demo surfaces sit in `.spec` cards (`background:#fff; border:1px solid #e6e9f0; border-radius:24px; box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(20,24,35,.02), 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(20,24,35,.22)`). Labels use `.lbl` (`11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#4c5466`) and `.statelbl` (`11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; color:#4c5466`); hex tokens use `.codepill` (`font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size:11.5px`); color dots use `.swatch` (`14px round`). The hero backdrop is `.dotgrid` = `radial-gradient(rgba(20,24,35,.06) 1px, transparent 1px)` at `background-size:22px 22px`.

The dense Sizes and States tables stay legible on mobile by scrolling rather than clipping: wrap each in `.scroll-x` (`overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch`) and give the grids a `min-width` (`.sizes-grid` min-width 560px with columns `96px minmax(180px,1fr) minmax(180px,1fr)`; `.states-grid` min-width 760px with columns `150px repeat(6, minmax(98px,1fr))`), plus a subtle 6px scrollbar thumb (`#dfe3ea`, rounded). Everything else reflows by stacking the `md:grid-cols-2`/`md:grid-cols-3` grids to a single column and hiding the `hidden md:flex` nav links and the `hidden sm:inline` Docs link.

Emphasis words in the hero headline are gradient-clipped text (`bg-clip-text text-transparent` with `background-image:var(--g-tl)` on 'glow' and `var(--g-ca)` on 'state'). The closing CTA is a dark band with a four-stop gradient border: an outer `rounded-[28px] p-[1.6px]` element with `background-image:linear-gradient(100deg,#14b8a6,#a3e635 45%,#ffb020 70%,#ff6b4a)` wrapping an inner `rounded-[26px] bg-ink-950` (#0a0d15) panel holding white extrabold copy and two gradient pill CTAs.

structured.special_notes: Exact tokens (Tailwind config). Ink scale: 50 #f7f8fa, 100 #eef0f4, 200 #dfe3ea, 300 #c4cad6, 400 #9aa3b4, 500 #6b7384, 600 #4c5466, 700 #363d4d, 800 #222836, 900 #141823, 950 #0a0d15. Accents: teal 400 #2dd4bf / 500 #14b8a6 / 600 #0d9488; lime 400 #a3e635 / 500 #84cc16; coral 400 #ff8a6b / 500 #ff6b4a / 600 #f0502d; amber 400 #ffc24a / 500 #ffb020. Gradients: --g-tl linear-gradient(100deg,#14b8a6 0%,#5fce8f 48%,#a3e635 100%) (hover --g-tl-hover #0d9488/#4cc485/#92d822, active --g-tl-active #0a7d72/#3aac6f/#7bbd16); --g-ca linear-gradient(100deg,#ff6b4a 0%,#ff8f3a 50%,#ffb020 100%) (hover --g-ca-hover #f0502d/#ff7d23/#f59e0a, active --g-ca-active #db4321/#ef6f17/#de8b00). Focus ring --ring: 0 0 0 3px #f7f8fa, 0 0 0 5px rgba(20,184,166,.55) (coral variants 0 0 0 5px rgba(255,107,74,.55)). Fill text colors: teal #06241f, coral #3a1605; outline core text teal #0a7d72, coral #c63d1d; soft bg/text teal #e8faf5/#0a7d72, coral #fff0eb/#c63d1d. Pill tokens: border-radius 9999px, 700 weight, border 1.6px, transition background-position .35s + box-shadow .22s + transform .12s. Sizes: XS 34px/px-16/12.5px, SM 40px/px-20/13.5px, MD 48px/px-26/15px, LG 58px/px-34/16.5px; icon variants are equal-width squares at 40/48/58px. Treatments: FILL (.g-tl/.g-ca) gradient bg with background-size 140% 100% that slides on hover + colored drop shadow + inset white highlight; OUTLINE (.o-tl/.o-ca) a 1.6px gradient ring via padding:1.6px + an inner white .core pill; SOFT (.s-tl/.s-ca) tinted bg + deep accent text; ICON (.btn-icon-sm/md/lg) square. Forced-state helpers .is-hover/.is-active/.is-focus/.is-disabled/.is-loading mirror the real pseudo-states so the static grid shows all six. .spec card = #fff/1px #e6e9f0/24px radius/0 18px 40px -28px shadow; .lbl 11px/700/uppercase/.14em #4c5466; .statelbl 11px/600/.04em #4c5466; .codepill ui-monospace 11.5px; .swatch 14px round; .dotgrid radial-gradient(rgba(20,24,35,.06) 1px) 22px. Layout: a sticky top-0 z-50 frosted nav (bg-[#f7f8fa]/80 backdrop-blur-md), a .dotgrid hero with a live-preview spec card, a centered mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 main of five sections (01 Variants two-column, 02 Sizes scroll table, 03 States six-state scroll table, 04 Icons six cards, 05 Tokens swatch cards + gradient-bordered ink-950 CTA), and a light footer. Dense Sizes/States tables scroll horizontally (.scroll-x + min-width grids) instead of clipping at 390px; md grids stack to one column and the nav links + Docs link hide. The prompt-library value is the transferable two-gradient pill token system plus the section-by-section state/size documentation layout for any button set.
